Up to 100% tuition coverage for select graduate programs

nationality: International students who are not US citizens

name: University of Jordan International Student Scholarships

Administrative support for enrollment and visa procedures

nationality: International students; some restricted by bilateral agreements

name: Sultan Qaboos University Scholarships, Sponsorship & Financial Support

benefits: Tuition coverage for eligible international students

nationality: International students including GCC and partner countries

name: AUBH International Student Scholarship Awards

name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at AUB
provider: American University of Beirut, with the Mastercard Foundation
description: Provides full scholarships to academically talented students with limited financial means, primarily from African countries, Lebanon, and refugee communities, with leadership development and mentorship.

benefits: Monthly stipend during fall and spring semesters

nationality: Open to students of any nationality

Annual scholarship quotas by nationality via Egyptian embassies

name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)

benefits: Full tuition waiver via host university

nationality: Open to applicants of any country of origin

name: University of Macau International Student Scholarship
description: Automatically considers eligible international applicants to full-time Bachelor's and Master's programmes, with priority to students who studied outside mainland China, Macao, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Deadlines vary or are rolling — confirm exact dates on the official site.
benefits: Some tiers include teaching assistantship stipend

nationality: International applicants not originally from mainland China, Macao, Hong Kong, or Taiwan

name: UNESCO Great Wall Fellowship Programme
provider: UNESCO and Ministry of Education of China
description: Co-sponsored by UNESCO and China, funds nationals of 135 developing UNESCO Member States to undertake visiting scholar, Master's, or Doctoral study in China.

nationality: Nationals of 135 developing UNESCO Member States

name: Confucius Institute Scholarship (CIS)
provider: Center for Language Education and Cooperation (CLEC), China
duration: 1 academic year up to full degree
description: Funds international students to study Chinese language and culture, or Chinese-language-taught degree programmes, at more than 150 partner Chinese universities.

nationality: Non-Chinese citizens worldwide, nominated via a local Confucius Institute

name: JASSO Student Exchange Support Program
description: Provides monthly stipends to international students accepted into a Japanese institution under a formal student exchange agreement for short-term study. Deadlines vary or are rolling — confirm exact dates on the official site.

nationality: Students from any country maintaining diplomatic relations with Japan

name: Chinese Government Scholarship – Pacific Islands Forum Program
provider: Ministry of Education of China / China Scholarship Council
description: Established specifically for citizens of Pacific Islands Forum member countries, funding undergraduate, graduate, and scholar-level study and research in China. Deadlines vary or are rolling — confirm exact dates on the official site.

nationality: Citizens of Pacific Islands Forum member countries

name: Taiwan/ROC – Pacific Islands Forum Scholarship Scheme
provider: Government of Taiwan, with the Pacific Islands Forum Secretariat
description: Supports citizens of Pacific Islands Forum member countries in fields such as commerce, medicine, engineering, marine science, information systems, and agriculture, including a preparatory Mandarin year. Deadlines vary or are rolling — confirm exact dates on the official site.
benefits: Fields of study prioritized by member countries

nationality: Citizens of Pacific Islands Forum member countries

name: Ghana Scholarship Secretariat Foreign Scholarships
provider: Ghana Scholarship Secretariat, Office of the President
amount: Tuition and stipend support for study abroad (varies by partner country/university)
description: The Ghana Scholarship Secretariat, under the Office of the President, administers government scholarships for Ghanaian students to pursue tertiary education both locally and abroad, including bilateral arrangements such as those with China and Koc University in Turkey. Applications are processed free of charge through the online portal.

name: Pan African University Scholarship Program
provider: African Union Commission / Pan African University
amount: Full tuition, accommodation and living expenses
description: The Pan African University Scholarship Program is an African Union initiative supporting postgraduate study at the PAU network of institutes hosted across the continent, focused on fields vital to Africa's development such as science, governance, and sustainability. It offers fully funded Master's and PhD scholarships covering tuition, accommodation and living expenses.
benefits: Study at PAU institutes across Africa

name: Bilateral Education Agreement (BEA) Scholarship
provider: Federal Scholarship Board, Federal Ministry of Education, Nigeria
amount: Tuition/accommodation by host country plus $6,000/year Nigerian government stipend
duration: 4-9 years depending on level and country
description: The Bilateral Education Agreement Scholarship is awarded by Nigeria's Federal Scholarship Board under agreements with partner countries including Russia, China, Hungary, Serbia, Romania, Morocco, Algeria and Egypt. Host countries cover tuition and accommodation while the Nigerian government provides an annual stipend for feeding, transport, and materials.
benefits: Tuition and accommodation via host country

name: PTDF Overseas Postgraduate Scholarship Scheme
amount: Fully funded: tuition, accommodation, airfare, and living expenses
description: PTDF's Overseas Postgraduate Scholarship Scheme is an annual Nigerian government program sponsoring MSc and PhD study at partner universities in the United Kingdom, France, Germany, and Malaysia in fields relevant to the oil and gas industry. It is administered by the Petroleum Technology Development Fund, a Nigerian federal government agency.

name: WASCAL Graduate Studies Programme
provider: West African Science Service Centre on Climate Change and Adapted Land Use (WASCAL)
amount: Full scholarship covering tuition, stipend and research costs
description: WASCAL, funded by Germany's Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) together with its West African member countries, offers full Master's and PhD scholarships in climate change and land use fields at leading West African universities. The centre's member countries include Benin, Burkina Faso, Cabo Verde, Cote d'Ivoire, Ghana, Guinea, The Gambia, Mali, Niger, Nigeria, Senegal and Togo.
benefits: Study at leading West African universities

name: AIMS Master's in Mathematical Sciences Scholarship
amount: Full scholarship covering tuition, accommodation, meals and travel
description: AIMS offers fully funded Master's scholarships in mathematical sciences at its centres across Africa (South Africa, Senegal, Ghana, Cameroon, Rwanda, Tanzania). Applicants must hold a four-year degree in mathematics or a related science/engineering field with a strong mathematics component, and admission is via a free online application including a motivation letter and mathematics assessment.

name: RUFORUM-Mastercard Foundation TAGDev 2.0 Scholarship
provider: Regional Universities Forum for Capacity Building in Agriculture (RUFORUM)
amount: Full scholarship covering tuition, upkeep and other costs
description: The Transforming African Agricultural Universities (TAGDev 2.0) programme is a 10-year (2023-2033) partnership between RUFORUM and the Mastercard Foundation providing undergraduate and Master's scholarships in agriculture and agribusiness to economically disadvantaged but academically able young Africans across RUFORUM's network of 175 universities in 40 African countries. Female applicants, refugees, internally displaced persons and persons with disabilities are especially encouraged to apply.

name: Islamic Development Bank Merit Scholarship Programme for High Technology (MSP)
amount: Fully funded tuition plus monthly living stipend
description: The IsDB Merit Scholarship Programme for High Technology supports PhD study and postdoctoral research in high-technology fields for nationals of IsDB member countries, many of which are African. Applicants must be nominated by their university or employer and the programme covers tuition paid directly to the university plus a monthly living allowance.

name: OWSD PhD Fellowships for Women Scientists from Developing Countries
provider: Organization for Women in Science for the Developing World (OWSD)
amount: Monthly living allowance, travel allowance, and research support
description: OWSD, based at TWAS in Italy, offers PhD fellowships to women scientists from Science and Technology Lagging Countries, many of which are in Africa, to conduct research at a centre of excellence in a developing country outside their own. Fellows must hold an MSc in a natural, engineering, or IT science and the programme aims to build a new generation of women leaders in science.
benefits: Research training at a centre of excellence

nationality: Science and Technology Lagging Countries, including many African nations

name: OWSD Early Career Fellowship
provider: Organization for Women in Science for the Developing World (OWSD)
amount: Research grant and career development funding
description: The OWSD Early Career Fellowship supports early-career women scientists in Science and Technology Lagging Countries, including many African nations, who have completed a PhD in the last ten years, providing research funding and career development support at their home institution.

nationality: Science and Technology Lagging Countries, including many African nations

name: African Development Bank-Japan Africa Dream Scholarship (JADS)
provider: African Development Bank (AfDB) and Government of Japan
amount: Full tuition plus JPY 140,000/month living allowance
description: JADS is a capacity-building scholarship jointly run by the African Development Bank and the Government of Japan for African professionals to pursue Master's degrees in Japan in fields such as energy, agriculture, health, and engineering. Applicants must be nationals of an AfDB member country, aged 35 or under, and apply directly through partner Japanese universities.

name: Namibia Students Financial Assistance Fund (NSFAF) Scholarship
provider: Namibia Students Financial Assistance Fund, Ministry of Higher Education
fields: Priority Fields as designated by NSFAF
amount: Tuition, registration, accommodation and study materials (loan/grant)
description: NSFAF, established in 1995 and run by Namibia's Ministry of Higher Education, Training and Innovation, provides financial aid in the form of loans and a limited number of grants to Namibian students pursuing tertiary education locally and abroad, based on academic merit and household income thresholds.

name: Zawadi Africa Education Fund Scholarship
amount: Full scholarship at partner universities across Africa and abroad
description: Zawadi Africa provides scholarships to academically gifted young women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds across Africa to pursue undergraduate education at over 80 partner institutions in countries including the United States, Uganda, Ghana, South Africa, and Kenya. The organization also provides mentorship and leadership development to scholars.

name: Australia Awards Africa
provider: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, and travel costs
description: Australia Awards Africa is the Australian Government's flagship development scholarship for African professionals, offering fully funded Master's study in Australia. Scholars are expected to return to their home countries after completion to contribute to national development, and the program is administered for eligible African countries under Australia's Africa development assistance program.

name: CODESRIA Fellowship and Grants Programme
provider: Council for the Development of Social Science Research in Africa (CODESRIA)
description: CODESRIA, headquartered in Dakar, Senegal, is a pan-African social science research council that offers grants and fellowships including thesis-writing support, small grants, and its Academic Diaspora programme connecting scholars with African universities. Calls for applications are posted periodically on its website for African graduate students and researchers.

name: Allan Gray Orbis Foundation Fellowship
amount: University funding plus entrepreneurial development support
description: The Allan Gray Orbis Foundation Fellowship supports young achievers transitioning into university across Southern Africa (with offices in South Africa and Namibia), combining funding for university study with entrepreneurial development support and lifelong membership of a Fellows' alumni community.

name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarship Scheme
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend of £1,452 (£1,781 in London)
description: The Commonwealth Shared Scholarship Scheme, funded by the UK Government, supports full-time Master's study in the UK for students from least developed and lower-middle-income Commonwealth countries, including Botswana, Cameroon, Eswatini, Gabon, Ghana, Kenya, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, Nigeria, Rwanda, Sierra Leone, South Africa, Tanzania, The Gambia, Togo, Uganda and Zambia. It covers tuition, airfare, and a monthly stipend.

name: Beit Trust Scholarship
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, visa costs and flights
description: The Beit Trust offers postgraduate scholarships for nationals and permanent residents of Zambia, Zimbabwe, and Malawi to study Master's degrees (PhD funding is rare) at partner universities in the UK, including Oxford, Cambridge and Edinburgh, or in South Africa. Selection weighs academic achievement, professional experience, leadership, and a firm commitment to return home after study.

name: Mwl. Julius K. Nyerere Memorial Master's Degree Scholarship
provider: Higher Education Students' Loans Board (HESLB), Tanzania
description: Named after Tanzania's founding president, this government scholarship administered by HESLB supports outstanding Tanzanian students pursuing Master's degrees, with detailed eligibility and funding guidelines published annually by the Board.

name: Samia Scholarship
provider: Higher Education Students' Loans Board (HESLB), Tanzania
description: The Samia Scholarship is a Tanzanian government scholarship programme administered by HESLB, supporting qualified Tanzanian students in higher education, with annually updated guidelines and qualified-student lists published by the Board for each academic year.

name: TETFund Academic Staff Training and Development (AST&D) Intervention
amount: Tuition and research support for academic staff (local and overseas)
description: TETFund's Academic Staff Training and Development intervention provides funding for Nigerian public tertiary institution staff to pursue Master's and PhD studies, including at overseas universities, as part of TETFund's mandate to strengthen Nigeria's higher education workforce. Guidelines and beneficiary institution allocations are published by TETFund.
benefits: Support for local and overseas study

name: HELB Postgraduate Scholarship
description: HELB, Kenya's Higher Education Loans Board, offers partial postgraduate scholarships to Kenyan students enrolled in Master's and PhD programmes at local universities, valued at Kshs 200,000 and Kshs 450,000 respectively for the 2026-2027 cycle.
benefits: Available for local Master's and PhD study

name: Rotary Yoneyama Memorial Foundation Scholarship
description: The Rotary Yoneyama Memorial Foundation, supported by contributions from Japanese Rotary members, provides monthly stipends to non-Japanese students who are scheduled to enroll in or are already enrolled at a Japanese university or graduate school. It is one of the largest privately funded scholarship programs in Japan for international students.

nationality: Non-Japanese citizens residing outside Japan until enrollment

name: Honjo International Scholarship Foundation Scholarship
description: The Honjo International Scholarship Foundation offers direct, non-repayable monthly stipends to outstanding international graduate students studying in Japan, with amounts varying by program length. Applicants apply directly to the foundation without requiring university pre-selection.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ¥180,000–¥230,000 depending on program duration

nationality: Non-Japanese citizens enrolled in or admitted to a Japanese graduate program

name: Ajinomoto Scholarship for ASEAN+One International Students
description: This scholarship enables students from Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Vietnam and Russia to secure funding before arrival in Japan to pursue master's studies mainly in the sciences at designated Japanese graduate schools. It covers a research-student period followed by the master's course and is intended to cultivate future leaders for Asia.
benefits: ¥150,000/month as research student, ¥180,000/month as master's student
Examination, admission and tuition fees covered in full

name: JASSO Honors Scholarship for Privately Financed International Students
description: JASSO, the Japanese government-affiliated organization supporting international education, provides monthly stipends to privately financed (self-funded) international students already enrolled at Japanese universities, colleges of technology, or Japanese language institutions. Students cannot apply directly; they are nominated by their host institution based on academic merit and financial need.
benefits: Monthly stipend paid through the host institution
Available at partner universities and language schools nationwide

nationality: Privately financed international students already studying in Japan

name: KOICA Scholarship Program
description: KOICA, Korea's official development cooperation agency, offers fully funded master's and doctoral scholarships to government officials and public-sector employees from developing countries under its capacity-building initiative. Applicants must be officially nominated by their home government or employer.
benefits: Monthly living allowance and settlement allowance

nationality: Citizens of KOICA partner developing countries, government-nominated

name: POSCO Asia Fellowship
description: The POSCO TJ Park Foundation's Asia Fellowship funds STEM master's and doctoral study at nine partner South Korean universities for outstanding students holding citizenship of an Asian country. Roughly 50 fellows are selected, with applicants able to shortlist up to three partner universities.

name: KAIST International Scholarship
provider: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
description: KAIST automatically considers all admitted international students for institutional scholarship funding when 'KAIST Scholarship' is selected during the regular admission application; there is no separate scholarship application. Awards typically cover full tuition and a living stipend for the duration of the degree, contingent on academic performance.
benefits: No separate application required beyond admission

name: UNESCO/China Great Wall Co-Sponsored Fellowships Programme
description: Co-sponsored by UNESCO and the Government of China, this fellowship offers around 75 places annually for students and researchers from developing UNESCO Member States to pursue degree study or supervised research in China. The China Scholarship Council manages recruitment and routine administration under entrustment from China's Ministry of Education.

nationality: Nationals of developing UNESCO Member States nominated via National Commissions for UNESCO

name: Beijing Government Scholarship (BGS)
amount: Tuition, accommodation and living allowance (varies by category)
description: The Beijing Government Scholarship supports outstanding international students studying at more than 50 host higher education institutions in Beijing. It is divided into Category A (tuition, accommodation, living expenses, insurance), Category B (tuition, accommodation, insurance) and Category C (tuition and insurance), with applications submitted through the host institution.

nationality: Non-Chinese citizens applying via a Beijing host institution

name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (SGS)
amount: Type A: tuition, accommodation, living allowance; Type B: tuition only
description: Established in 2006, the Shanghai Government Scholarship supports outstanding non-Chinese students pursuing undergraduate, master's, or doctoral degrees at higher education institutions in Shanghai. Type A covers tuition, accommodation, living allowance and insurance, while Type B covers tuition and insurance only.

nationality: Non-Chinese citizens; undergraduate applicants under 25, master's under 35

name: Yenching Academy Scholarship
description: The Yenching Academy at Peking University offers a fully funded two-year interdisciplinary master's degree in China Studies for students worldwide, established in 2014. All admitted Yenching Scholars receive full financial support regardless of nationality or financial background.
benefits: Health insurance and funded field trips

name: A*STAR Graduate Scholarship (AGS)
provider: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)
amount: Full tuition + stipend + overseas research attachment
description: A*STAR's Graduate Scholarship funds up to four years of PhD or EngD study at a Singapore university across STEM, Semicon, Quantum, and Computing tracks, including a 12-month overseas research attachment. Non-Singaporean, non-permanent-resident awardees who accept the scholarship undertake a subsequent service commitment with Singapore-based companies.
benefits: Access to A*STAR research institute labs

nationality: Singapore Citizens/PRs preferred; other nationalities eligible with service bond

name: Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship (NPGS)
description: NPGS is NTU's premier PhD scholarship, awarded by the university president to outstanding graduates or final-year students beginning a full-time PhD, recognizing exceptional academic, research and leadership qualities. Open to all nationalities, though preference is given to Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents.

name: Nanyang Scholarship
amount: Full tuition + S$6,500 living stipend + allowances
description: The Nanyang Scholarship is NTU's foremost undergraduate award for outstanding incoming freshmen who show strong academics, leadership potential and co-curricular achievement. It is open to all nationalities and covers subsidized tuition plus a living stipend for the full course duration.

name: Bolashak International Scholarship
provider: Center for International Programs, Government of Kazakhstan
description: Established in 1993 by presidential decree, the Bolashak International Scholarship funds Kazakhstani citizens to pursue bachelor's, master's, PhD, residency or professional internship programs at leading foreign universities and organizations, with the operator being JSC 'Center for International Programs'. Recipients are selected through a competitive process and generally commit to returning to work in Kazakhstan.
benefits: Full tuition at approved foreign universities

nationality: Citizens of the Republic of Kazakhstan

name: Nazarbayev University International Student Scholarship
description: Nazarbayev University in Astana automatically considers admitted international students for institutional scholarships, including the full 'Abay Kunanbayev' award covering tuition, basic medical insurance and a monthly stipend, as well as citizenship-based awards covering 50-90% of tuition. No separate scholarship application is required beyond the standard admissions process.
benefits: Tuition waiver of 50-100% depending on award

name: National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic (NSP)
provider: Slovak Academic Information Agency (SAIA), Ministry of Education of the Slovak Republic
amount: Monthly stipend (€620-€1450 depending on level) + travel allowance
description: The Slovak government funds study and research stays for international students, PhD candidates, university teachers, researchers and artists at Slovak public universities and research institutions. Applications are submitted online via the official scholarships.sk portal, with two annual rounds.
benefits: No tuition fees at Slovak public universities
Open to students, PhD candidates, researchers and artists

name: Ad Futura Scholarship for Studies of Foreign Nationals in Slovenia
provider: Public Scholarship, Development, Disability and Maintenance Fund of the Republic of Slovenia (SRIPS)
amount: Tuition up to €15,000/year + living allowance up to €15,000/year
description: The Slovenian government fund awards Ad Futura scholarships to foreign nationals to study in Slovenia, including a Western Balkans track for natural sciences, technology and medicine, and a track for students from countries with bilateral development agreements with Slovenia. Awards cover tuition and living costs depending on country of origin.
benefits: Open to bachelor's, master's and doctoral applicants
Administered by a national public fund

nationality: Countries with development agreements with Slovenia

name: Croatian Government Scholarships (Bilateral Scholarships)
provider: Ministry of Science, Education and Youth of the Republic of Croatia / Agency for Mobility and EU Programmes
amount: Monthly stipend + tuition coverage + subsidized housing
deadline: Varies by year (typically spring for the following academic year)
duration: 4-5 months (Type A1), up to 10 months (Type A2), or 36 months (Type C1 for PhD)
description: Croatia offers bilateral government scholarships for foreign students, teachers and researchers to study Croatian language, spend part of a degree in Croatia, or complete a full PhD at an accredited Croatian institution. The programme covers tuition, provides a monthly stipend, and subsidizes housing and meals.

name: Romanian Government Scholarships for Foreign Citizens
provider: Romanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Ministry of Education
amount: Full tuition waiver + monthly stipend + free accommodation in student dorms
duration: 1 year (language year) plus full programme duration
description: The Romanian government offers scholarships to non-EU foreign citizens for bachelor's, master's and PhD study, applied for through the official Study in Romania platform. Most programmes are taught in Romanian and require one preparatory year of language study, though some PhD tracks are available in English or another foreign language.
benefits: One year of Romanian language preparation included

name: Bulgarian Government Scholarships for Foreign Students
provider: Government of Bulgaria / Ministry of Education and Science
description: The Bulgarian government offers scholarships to citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with Bulgaria (non-EU/EEA/Swiss nationals) to pursue bachelor's, master's and doctoral studies at Bulgarian state universities. Awards are granted on the basis of academic merit and require a valid secondary school diploma or equivalent qualification.

nationality: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss nationals from countries with diplomatic relations with Bulgaria

name: IKY Scholarships for Foreign Nationals
amount: Monthly stipend + tuition support (varies by call)
duration: Varies by programme (typically several months to 1 academic year)
description: IKY, Greece's national scholarships body, has awarded scholarships to foreign nationals for postgraduate studies, postdoctoral research, and Modern Greek Language and Culture programmes since the 1960s. Calls and availability vary year to year, and applicants should check the official IKY website for the current cycle's open programmes.
benefits: Support for postgraduate or postdoctoral research in Greece
Greek language and culture study option
Administered by Greece's national scholarship body

name: Estonian Government Scholarships (Study in Estonia)
provider: Estonian Education and Youth Board (Haridus- ja Noorteamet / HARNO)
description: Estonia funds degree scholarships for international students admitted to Master's or PhD programmes at Estonian higher education institutions, where tuition is already free for these levels. Applicants must hold a letter of acceptance from an Estonian university and demonstrate English proficiency.
benefits: Free tuition (standard for Master's/PhD in Estonia)
Open to all fields at Master's and PhD level
Short summer/winter school scholarships also available

name: Latvian State Scholarships
description: Latvia awards state scholarships to students, researchers and teaching staff from over 30 partner countries to study at Latvian higher education institutions under bilateral cooperation agreements. Applicants must already hold official confirmation of admission or enrollment from a Latvian institution when applying.
benefits: Available for bachelor's, master's and PhD study

nationality: Citizens of partner countries with bilateral agreements with Latvia

name: Lithuanian State Scholarships
provider: Government of the Republic of Lithuania / Ministry of Education, Science and Sport
amount: €592/month + tuition coverage up to national standard study cost
description: Lithuania offers around 70 annual scholarships to citizens of specified partner countries (including Ukraine, Georgia, Kazakhstan and others) and people of Lithuanian origin to study at Lithuanian higher education institutions. The scholarship combines a fixed monthly stipend with a grant covering tuition up to the nationally approved study cost.
benefits: Monthly stipend of 8 Basic Social Amounts (€592 in 2026)
Tuition cost coverage up to national standard
Available at bachelor's, master's and PhD level

nationality: Citizens of partner countries (e.g. Ukraine, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Moldova, Vietnam, and others)

name: EDUFI Fellowship
deadline: Varies by year (apply at least 5 months before intended start)
description: The EDUFI Fellowship helps Finnish universities recruit international doctoral researchers by funding a research stay in Finland. Applications must be submitted by the hosting Finnish university department on behalf of the candidate, who first needs to secure a supervisor willing to host the research.
benefits: Supports doctoral research stays of 3-12 months
Available to students starting a full PhD or a joint doctoral programme in Finland
Also open to doctoral researchers based abroad for shorter visits

name: Malta Government Endeavour Scholarships Scheme
provider: Ministry for Education, Sport, Youth, Research and Innovation (MEYR), Malta / co-financed by ESF+
description: Malta's flagship postgraduate scholarship scheme, co-financed by the European Social Fund Plus (ESF+), covers tuition fees and provides a study allowance for Master's and PhD candidates, and is open to both Maltese residents and international applicants. No English-language test is required to apply.
benefits: Open to both Maltese and international applicants

name: "la Caixa" Postdoctoral Junior Leader Incoming Fellowships
description: The 'la Caixa' Foundation funds early-career researchers to carry out postdoctoral research projects at host institutions in Spain or Portugal. Applicants must hold a PhD awarded between two and seven years before the call deadline, and the fellowship is one of Spain's most prestigious privately funded postdoctoral programmes.
benefits: Hosted at leading Spanish or Portuguese research centres

name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
description: ESOP is ETH Zurich's flagship merit scholarship for outstanding incoming Master's students, covering living and study costs plus a tuition waiver for the full duration of the degree. Applicants must be in the top tier of their Bachelor's cohort and apply during their Master's application to ETH Zurich.
benefits: Mentorship and access to an academic network
Covers the full regular Master's duration

name: Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (AMS)
description: The Amsterdam Merit Scholarship supports highly talented non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's programme at the University of Amsterdam. The award amount varies by faculty, up to €25,900, and requires a complete programme application submitted by the same January deadline.
benefits: Covers tuition and/or living costs depending on faculty

name: Deutschlandstipendium (Germany Scholarship)
provider: German Federal Ministry of Education and Research, in partnership with individual German universities
description: The Deutschlandstipendium is a national merit scholarship jointly funded by the German government and private sponsors, awarded through individual universities to strong students of any nationality enrolled at a public or state-recognized German university. Selection also considers civic engagement and personal circumstances, not only grades.
benefits: €300 per month, independent of parental income
Open to students of all nationalities enrolled in Germany

name: Invest Your Talent in Italy
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
description: This Italian government programme funds international students from a set list of eligible countries to pursue English-taught Master's degrees in Engineering, Architecture/Design, or Economics/Management at partner Italian universities, including a paid internship with an Italian company. It also includes free Italian language courses.

nationality: Citizens of a defined list of eligible countries (varies by call)

name: Icelandic Government Scholarship (Icelandic as a Second Language)
provider: Árni Magnússon Institute for Icelandic Studies / Ministry of Culture, Innovation and Higher Education
amount: Tuition coverage + monthly stipend for room and board
description: The Icelandic government funds around 12 scholarships annually for international students to study Icelandic as a Second Language at the University of Iceland, covering registration fees and a monthly stipend during the academic year. Basic prior knowledge of Icelandic and at least one year of prior humanities study are required.
benefits: Registration fee waiver at the University of Iceland
Monthly stipend for room and board

name: NORPART - Norwegian Partnership Programme for Global Academic Cooperation
provider: Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), Norwegian Ministry of Education and Research
amount: Full funding (student mobility grant, varies by project)
deadline: Varies by year (calls issued periodically to institutions)
duration: Several months up to a full Master's degree
description: NORPART funds academic partnerships between Norwegian higher education institutions and partner institutions in the Global South, enabling student mobility scholarships for full or partial degree study in Norway. Individuals do not apply directly; eligible students apply through a partner university participating in a funded NORPART project.
benefits: Available for partial or full Master's study
No tuition fees at Norwegian public universities

nationality: Students at partner institutions in eligible Global South countries

name: Gulbenkian Research Scholarships on Portuguese Culture for Foreigners
amount: Monthly stipend + travel and installation allowance
description: The Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation funds non-Portuguese doctoral candidates and senior researchers to conduct research in Portugal on topics connected to Portuguese history, art, literature or culture. Awardees must be affiliated with a Portuguese university and apply online via the foundation's MyGulbenkian portal.
benefits: Research stays of 2-10 months in Portugal

name: Visegrad Scholarship Program
country: Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, Slovakia (V4 region)
description: The International Visegrad Fund's scholarship programme funds Master's and post-Master's students and researchers to study or conduct research at over 190 accredited institutions across the Visegrad (Czechia, Hungary, Poland, Slovakia) and Eastern Partnership/Western Balkans region. Applications are submitted online through the My Visegrad portal with a letter of acceptance from the host institution.
benefits: €2,000 per semester paid to the host institution
Supports both study and research mobility

nationality: Citizens of Visegrad countries and select Eastern Partnership/Western Balkans countries

name: Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
description: Leiden University awards merit-based partial and full-tuition scholarships to excellent non-EU/EEA students admitted to one of its Master's programmes. Awards are granted based on academic excellence assessed as part of the university's regular admissions process, with no separate essay required.
benefits: Partial or full tuition fee reduction
Open to all faculties and Master's programmes

name: Sciences Po Emile Boutmy Scholarship
deadline: Varies by year (typically January for the following academic year)
duration: Full length of the Bachelor's or Master's programme
description: The Emile Boutmy Scholarship is Sciences Po's merit-based scholarship for non-EU international students admitted to its undergraduate or graduate programmes, intended to help cover tuition costs. Applicants must apply for the scholarship after receiving an offer of admission to a Sciences Po programme.
benefits: Available at both Bachelor's and Master's level
Open to all Sciences Po campuses and programmes
No separate exam required beyond admission

name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program
provider: U.S. Department of State / Institute of International Education (IIE)
deadline: Varies by country (embassy nomination, typically mid-year)
description: A Fulbright-affiliated, non-degree exchange program that brings accomplished mid-career professionals to the United States for a year of graduate-level study, professional affiliation, and leadership development. Administered by IIE and funded by the U.S. State Department's Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs. Candidates are nominated through U.S. embassies in eligible countries.

name: AAUW International Fellowships
description: AAUW awards fellowships for full-time graduate study or research in the United States to women who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents. For the 2026-27 cycle the fellowship supports master's, academic doctoral, and professional doctoral study in STEM disciplines at accredited institutions. Applications open August 17, 2026 and close September 17, 2026.
benefits: Access to AAUW's global network of women scholars

nationality: Non-US citizens or permanent residents (women only)

name: P.E.O. International Peace Scholarship
description: Established in 1949, the IPS Fund provides need-based scholarships to women from outside the United States and Canada pursuing graduate study at an accredited college or university in the U.S. or Canada. Recipients are expected to return to their home countries to apply their education. The maximum award is $12,500 per recipient.
benefits: Direct scholarship payment toward graduate study costs

nationality: Women who are not citizens or permanent residents of the US or Canada

name: Davis United World College Scholars Program
provider: Davis United World College Scholars Program
description: The world's largest privately funded international undergraduate scholarship program, co-founded by Shelby Davis, provides need-based financial aid to graduates of the 18 United World College (UWC) high schools attending over 100 partner colleges and universities in the U.S. More than 14,700 UWC alumni have received support since 2000.
benefits: Need-based financial aid supplementing institutional aid
Access to over 100 partner U.S. colleges

nationality: Graduates of a United World College, all nationalities

name: International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES)
deadline: Determined by UBC's undergraduate admission deadline
description: IMES are merit-based entrance scholarships automatically considered for exceptional international students entering undergraduate programs at UBC on a study permit. For 2026/27 awards range from $10,000 to $25,000 per year and are renewable for up to three additional years based on academic standing.
benefits: No separate application required beyond admission

nationality: International students entering UBC on a Canadian study permit

name: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Doctoral Scholarship
description: The Trudeau Foundation PhD Scholarship supports doctoral candidates in the humanities and social sciences whose research addresses issues relevant to Canada's future, in areas such as human rights, responsible citizenship, and the environment. About fifteen scholars are selected annually and gain mentorship and participation in Foundation events in addition to funding.
benefits: Up to $50,000/year for tuition and living expenses
Up to $20,000/year for research travel and networking

nationality: All nationalities enrolled in an eligible Canadian doctoral program

name: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA)
amount: Varies (funding value set by tri-agency guidelines)
description: The Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA), jointly administered by Canada's three federal research agencies, is the successor to the Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships and supports early-career researchers at Canadian institutions. International applicants are eligible if they completed or are completing their PhD at a Canadian institution, or are already conducting postdoctoral research in Canada.
benefits: Eligibility for supplements such as the Bora Laskin Fellowship or Indigenous Scholars Award

nationality: International applicants with a Canadian-earned or in-progress PhD

name: Ontario Trillium Scholarship
provider: Government of Ontario (administered by Ontario universities)
description: A Government of Ontario initiative to attract top international doctoral students to Ontario universities, providing $40,000 per year for up to four years. Universities nominate candidates through their own internal selection process, so applicants must first apply for admission to an eligible PhD program.

name: Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE)
provider: Fonds de recherche du Québec (FRQNT), Gouvernement du Québec
description: The PBEEE supports international students conducting doctoral research or postdoctoral work at Quebec universities and CCTTs, aiming to internationalize Quebec's research community. Doctoral scholarships pay $25,000/year for up to three years, and postdoctoral scholarships pay $35,000 for one year. Applicants must be preselected by a Quebec institution before applying.

nationality: Non-Canadian citizens/non-permanent residents, preselected by a Quebec institution

name: International Master's Award of Excellence (IMAE)
description: IMAE is awarded to eligible international students entering a research-based master's program at the University of Waterloo, worth $2,500 per term for up to five terms. No separate application is required; students are automatically considered based on their admission application and are nominated by their faculty.
benefits: Per-term award for up to 5 terms

name: Rotary Peace Fellowship
deadline: Varies by year (applications typically open in February)
description: Rotary funds up to 170 fellowships a year for leaders in peace and conflict resolution to study at Rotary Peace Centers, including university partners in the United States. The fellowship covers tuition and fees, room and board, round-trip transportation, and internship/field-study expenses for a two-year master's program, or a shorter professional development certificate.

name: Emerging Global Leader Scholarship
description: American University's AU EGLS covers all billable expenses (tuition, room, and board) for two incoming international undergraduates each year who require an F-1 or J-1 visa. It targets students from diverse and underrepresented backgrounds with demonstrated leadership, volunteerism, and community service.
benefits: Full tuition, room, and board for 4 years

nationality: International students requiring an F-1 or J-1 visa

name: Wesleyan Freeman Asian Scholars Program
description: Established in 1995, the Freeman Asian Scholars Program provides full scholarships (tuition, fees, room, board, supplies, and travel) for up to eleven exceptionally able students with demonstrated financial need from designated Asian countries to earn a bachelor's degree at Wesleyan University.
benefits: Full tuition, fees, room and board
Access to the Freeman Asian Scholars Association network

nationality: Citizens/permanent residents of China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, or Vietnam

name: Clark University Global Scholars Program
description: Clark University's Global Scholars Program (GSP) offers first-year international applicants who attended school overseas for at least four years a renewable merit scholarship of $15,000 to $25,000 per year, with up to an additional $5,000 in need-based aid available. Applicants opt in via the Common Application and complete a short supplementary essay.

nationality: International citizens who attended school overseas 4+ years

name: Berea College International Student Scholarship
amount: Full tuition (No-Tuition Promise) plus need-based aid
description: Berea College does not charge tuition to any admitted student, and admitted international students receive financial aid and scholarships covering 100% of tuition, room, board, and fees for their first year. Approximately 30 new international students are admitted each year, and on-campus jobs are available to help cover personal expenses.

name: Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarship (USES)
description: SFU's Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarship is offered to incoming high school applicants who demonstrate strong academic achievement and community contribution, with international student awards up to $140,000 and additional living-allowance support available for students with demonstrated financial need. A separate scholarship application is required in addition to admission.
benefits: Potential additional living allowance for financial need

name: University of Alberta Graduate Entrance Scholarship
description: The University of Alberta's Graduate Entrance Scholarship supports newly admitted graduate students, including international students, based on academic merit, with individual faculties managing nomination and adjudication. Award values and eligibility criteria vary by faculty and department.
benefits: One-time or renewable entrance award for new graduate students

name: Global Leadership Scholarship
description: Kalamazoo College awards a limited number of full-tuition Global Leadership Scholarships to incoming first-year international students, renewable all four years based on continued academic standing. Applicants must complete an admission interview and apply by the Early Decision/Early Action deadline of November 1; recipients may not combine this with other merit awards but can still apply for need-based aid.
benefits: Eligibility to also apply for need-based aid

name: Melbourne Research Scholarship
amount: Full tuition offset + AUD $39,500/year living allowance
deadline: Varies by faculty (typically Oct 31 for main round)
duration: Up to 3.5 years (PhD), up to 2 years (Master's by Research)
description: The Melbourne Research Scholarship is the University of Melbourne's primary funding scheme for domestic and international graduate research students, covering fees and a living allowance. Around 600 scholarships are awarded annually based on academic merit and research potential.
benefits: Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for international students

name: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship
description: ANU automatically assesses every international applicant for this tuition fee reduction based on academic merit, with no separate application required. It is designed to attract high-calibre international students across undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs.

nationality: All nationalities except Australia and New Zealand

name: UQ International Excellence Scholarship
description: UQ automatically assesses high-achieving international students applying to eligible undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs for this ongoing tuition reduction. No separate application is required beyond the standard admission application.

nationality: All nationalities except Australia and New Zealand

name: Monash International Merit Scholarship
description: Newly admitted international undergraduate students with an unconditional full course offer are automatically considered for this scholarship without a separate application. It rewards demonstrated academic excellence among incoming Monash undergraduates.
benefits: AUD $15,000 per annum for duration of degree

name: UNSW Scientia PhD Scholarship
description: UNSW's flagship PhD scheme funds candidates to work on research projects aligned with the university's strategic priorities, providing a tax-free living allowance, tuition coverage, and career development support. Both domestic and international candidates may apply.

name: University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship
description: This scholarship supports new international students of high calibre enrolling in undergraduate degrees, Postgraduate Diplomas, or taught master's programmes of one year or more. Around 50 scholarships are offered per intake, twice a year.
benefits: Up to NZD $10,000 towards tuition fees

name: International Academic Excellence Scholarship
description: Awarded to newly starting international Bachelor's degree students who demonstrate outstanding academic ability in their home secondary school system. Applicants are automatically considered for international scholarships when they apply for admission through the university's eVision system.
benefits: First-year residential college fee waiver component

name: Wellington Doctoral Scholarship
provider: Victoria University of Wellington (Te Herenga Waka)
deadline: Varies by round (3 rounds per year)
description: Open to graduates of any university, within or outside New Zealand, seeking their first doctoral qualification in any discipline. Around 110 scholarships are awarded annually across three application rounds, assessed on academic merit with no separate application form beyond PhD admission.

name: International Excellence Scholarship
description: High-achieving international students commencing a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at JCU are automatically assessed for this 25% tuition reduction during the admissions process. Recipients must maintain a strong GPA to retain the award each semester.
benefits: 25% tuition reduction for full degree duration

nationality: All nationalities except Australia and New Zealand

name: International Student Academic Excellence Scholarship
description: Griffith automatically assesses applicants for this award covering 25% of tuition fees when they apply for an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program. It rewards outstanding academic achievement among incoming international students.

nationality: All nationalities except Australia and New Zealand

name: Curtin International Merit Scholarship
description: Curtin offers this merit scholarship to eligible international undergraduate and postgraduate coursework students, providing a tuition fee credit toward their first year of study. Eligibility is assessed as part of the standard admissions process.
benefits: Up to 25% of first-year tuition fees
Applies to undergraduate and postgraduate coursework

name: Adelaide Scholarships International (ASI)
duration: Up to 3 years (PhD), up to 2 years (Master's by Research)
description: ASI is the University of Adelaide's flagship fully-funded award for outstanding international research students, covering full tuition fees, an annual living allowance, and health insurance. It is awarded purely on academic merit and research potential by the Graduate Scholarships Committee.

nationality: All nationalities except Australia and New Zealand

name: Australian Government Research Training Program (International)
duration: Up to 4 years (PhD), up to 2 years (Research Master's)
description: RTP is an Australian Government block grant scheme that funds eligible universities to support domestic and international students undertaking research doctorates and research master's degrees. Students apply through their chosen participating university rather than directly to the government.
benefits: Living and relocation allowances at some institutions

name: QUT International Merit Scholarship
description: QUT automatically considers eligible international applicants to select undergraduate and postgraduate courses for this ongoing 25% tuition reduction, provided they meet academic entry and English language requirements. No separate application is needed.
benefits: QUT College of Excellence membership eligibility

name: Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship
duration: Applied in first year of study
description: Supports talented new international students enrolling for the first time in undergraduate or postgraduate programmes at the University of Waikato. Awarded based on academic achievement, with applicants needing a conditional or unconditional offer of place.
benefits: Open to undergraduate and postgraduate applicants

name: Peking University International Students Scholarship
amount: Full or partial tuition waiver + stipend (varies by category)
deadline: Varies by year (typically Dec-Mar for degree programs)
description: Peking University offers its own scholarships to admitted international students in addition to Chinese Government Scholarship placements, administered through the Graduate School and Office of International Students. Awards are merit-based and assessed alongside the standard admission application.

name: Tsinghua University Scholarship for International Students
amount: Full or partial tuition waiver + possible stipend
description: Tsinghua University runs its own scholarship scheme for admitted international degree students, distinct from the national Chinese Government Scholarship, covering tuition and in some cases living costs. Applications are processed through Tsinghua's International Students admissions office.
benefits: Possible living allowance for top awardees

name: Fudan University Scholarship for International Students
description: Fudan University's International Students Office administers its own merit-based scholarships for international degree-seeking students, alongside placements for the Chinese Government Scholarship and Shanghai Government Scholarship. Recipients must register each semester and submit periodic progress feedback.
benefits: Access to cultural activities and orientation tours

name: Shanghai Government Scholarship
amount: Tuition waiver + accommodation + monthly stipend (varies by type)
description: The Shanghai Government Scholarship is funded by the Shanghai Municipal Education Commission and administered through partner universities in Shanghai, including Fudan University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. It supports international students pursuing degree programs, with Type A providing full support and Type B partial support.
benefits: Monthly living stipend for full awardees

name: Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship Scheme
provider: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
deadline: Varies by programme (aligned with PhD admission rounds)
description: CUHK's Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship Scheme funds outstanding doctoral candidates admitted to full-time PhD programmes, evaluated automatically alongside the standard PhD application with no separate form. It targets candidates with strong academic records, research achievements, and leadership potential.
benefits: HK$30,000 travel allowance across study period

name: HKU Presidential PhD Scholar Programme
amount: Monthly stipend + tuition waiver + conference travel
description: HKU's Presidential PhD Scholar Programme identifies and funds outstanding doctoral candidates from around the world, distinct from the government-funded Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme. It covers tuition, provides a monthly stipend, and includes support for conference and research-related travel.

name: HKUST Scholarship for International Students
provider: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
amount: Full or partial tuition waiver, varies by scheme
description: HKUST offers a range of entrance and merit scholarships for international undergraduate and postgraduate students, covering tuition and in some cases living costs, assessed as part of the university's admissions process.

name: UTokyo Fellowship
duration: Up to 1 year (renewable, standard program duration)
description: Established in 2004, the UTokyo Fellowship is a research grant-in-aid supporting outstanding, self-funded international students pursuing degrees at the University of Tokyo. Around 44 new recipients were selected in the most recent academic year, with applications submitted through the applicant's affiliated Graduate School.
benefits: Access to named sub-scholarships for specific nationalities

name: Design the Future Award for International Students
amount: Full academic fees + living expenses + one-time admission payment
description: Keio University's premier scholarship for outstanding international students covers full tuition and living expenses to help develop future global leaders. It is one of several scholarship schemes funded through Keio's scholarship endowment, among the largest of any Japanese university.

name: Waseda University Scholarship for International Students
amount: Partial tuition waiver or monthly stipend, varies by scheme
description: Waseda University offers its own privately and university-funded scholarships to admitted international students in addition to Japanese government MEXT scholarships, covering partial tuition or providing a monthly stipend depending on the scheme.
benefits: Partial tuition reduction or monthly stipend

name: Kyoto University Scholarship for International Students
amount: Varies by scheme (tuition reduction and/or stipend)
description: Kyoto University administers a range of scholarships and financial support for enrolled international students covering tuition, housing, and living costs, coordinated through its education and campus life support office.

name: Global Leader Scholarship (Type A)
amount: 100% tuition/entrance fee waiver + KRW 500,000/month living support
description: Korea University's top-tier merit scholarship for incoming international graduate students covers full entrance and tuition fees plus a monthly living allowance, requiring a strong GPA and English or Korean proficiency along with department recommendation.
benefits: 100% entrance fee and tuition fee waiver
KRW 500,000 monthly living support during semester

name: SNU Global Scholarship (GS)
amount: Tuition waiver + monthly stipend, varies by level
description: SNU's Global Scholarship supports incoming international degree students with tuition and living cost assistance, administered by the Office of Global Affairs alongside the SNU President Fellowship for high-achieving graduate researchers.
benefits: Monthly living stipend for eligible recipients

name: KAIST International Student Scholarship
provider: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
amount: Tuition waiver + stipend, varies by level
duration: Duration of degree program (subject to academic performance)
description: KAIST provides financial support to admitted international undergraduate and graduate students in science and engineering fields, covering tuition and, for many graduate students, a monthly stipend funded through the institute or research labs.

name: Yonsei University International Scholarship
amount: Partial to full tuition waiver, varies by scheme
description: Yonsei University's Office of International Affairs offers merit-based scholarships to admitted international students at all degree levels, with awards ranging from partial to full tuition coverage depending on academic record and continued performance.

name: NTU Scholarships for Overseas Students
amount: Varies by scholarship source (government, university, or college)
description: NTU coordinates multiple scholarship sources for overseas students, funded by the Taiwanese government, external organizations, and individual colleges, applied for alongside the standard admission application. Being offered a scholarship does not guarantee admission and vice versa.
benefits: Tuition or living cost support depending on source
Multiple scholarship sources coordinated by NTU

name: National Tsing Hua University International Student Scholarship
amount: Tuition waiver and/or monthly stipend, varies by level
description: National Tsing Hua University, one of Taiwan's leading research universities, offers scholarships to admitted international degree students covering tuition fees and, for many graduate students, a monthly living stipend.
benefits: Monthly stipend for eligible graduate students

name: Macao SAR Government Scholarship
description: The Macao SAR Government offers scholarships to international students admitted to higher education institutions in Macau, covering tuition fees and providing a monthly living allowance, administered through the Tertiary Education Services Office and partner institutions.

name: NTU Research Scholarship
amount: Full tuition plus monthly stipend (international students S$2,900-3,000/month)
description: The standard NTU Research Scholarship supports full-time graduate research students, including international applicants, with tuition coverage and a monthly stipend that increases after passing the Qualifying Exam. There is no bond attached and awards are renewable based on progress.

name: ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship (AUS)
amount: 100% coverage of subsidised tuition fees after MOE Tuition Grant
description: The ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship, funded by Singapore's Ministry of Education, is offered to outstanding ASEAN nationals (excluding Singapore) admitted to undergraduate programmes at NUS, NTU, SMU, SUTD, SIT or SUSS. Recipients must take up the MOE Tuition Grant, which carries a three-year work bond in Singapore after graduation.

nationality: Citizens or permanent residents of ASEAN member states, excluding Singapore

name: Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) Scholarship
description: MTCP is Malaysia's South-South cooperation scholarship, established in 1980, funding postgraduate students from eligible developing countries to pursue Master's degrees at approved Malaysian universities. It covers tuition, airfare and living support for the duration of the programme.

nationality: Citizens of eligible MTCP recipient developing countries

name: Universiti Malaya Postgraduate Financial Aid / Bright Scholarship
amount: Full tuition fee waiver plus monthly stipend
description: Universiti Malaya offers postgraduate financial aid schemes, including the UM Bright Scholarship, to outstanding local and international candidates pursuing a research PhD. The scholarship provides a full tuition fee waiver plus a monthly stipend.

name: International Graduate Student Scholarship (IGSS)
description: UPM's International Graduate Student Scholarship offers a partial tuition fee waiver to PhD applicants from Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East and Africa who already hold a Master's degree and have at least one published journal article. Priority is given to research aligned with UPM/Malaysia priority areas.

name: TICA Annual International Training Course (AITC)
provider: Thailand International Cooperation Agency (TICA), Ministry of Foreign Affairs
amount: Tuition/training fees, airfare (for eligible countries), Thai visa fee and daily allowance
description: AITC is TICA's flagship short-term training scholarship, running around 30-35 courses annually for participants from developing partner countries under themes such as agriculture, health, and sustainable development. It has run since 1991 as part of Thailand's development cooperation programme.

nationality: Citizens of TICA-eligible developing partner countries

name: Chulalongkorn University Graduate Scholarship Programme for ASEAN or Non-ASEAN Countries
amount: Tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation and round-trip airfare
description: Chulalongkorn University's Graduate Scholarship Programme fully funds international students from ASEAN and non-ASEAN countries pursuing Master's or Doctoral degrees, covering tuition, stipend, accommodation and airfare. Applications are reviewed by the chosen faculty before forwarding to the Office of Academic Affairs.

name: Mahidol University Postgraduate Scholarships for International Students
amount: Tuition fees and other expenses (varies by faculty)
description: Mahidol University offers postgraduate scholarships to international students across its faculties and institutes, covering tuition fees and other study-related expenses. Support is coordinated through Mahidol's Global Partnerships Division and individual faculties.

name: LPDP Scholarship (Indonesia Endowment Fund for Education)
provider: Lembaga Pengelola Dana Pendidikan (LPDP), Ministry of Finance, Indonesia
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, and other academic support
description: LPDP is the Indonesian government's flagship scholarship fund, enabling Indonesian citizens to pursue Master's or Doctoral degrees at universities in Indonesia or abroad, including across Southeast Asia. It is administered by the Indonesia Endowment Fund for Education under the Ministry of Finance and covers tuition and living costs.

name: Indonesian International Student Mobility Awards (IISMA)
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Research, and Technology (Kemdikbudristek), Indonesia
amount: Tuition waiver, living allowance, travel and visa costs for one semester abroad
description: IISMA is an Indonesian government scholarship scheme funding Indonesian undergraduate and vocational students for a one-semester mobility program at partner universities and industries overseas. It is managed centrally by Indonesia's Ministry of Education, Culture, Research, and Technology, with over 100 partner institutions worldwide.

name: Darmasiswa Scholarship Programme
provider: Ministry of Education and Culture, Indonesia
description: Darmasiswa is a non-degree scholarship offered by Indonesia's Ministry of Education and Culture to citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with Indonesia, to study Indonesian language, arts or culture at a chosen Indonesian university for one year. It covers tuition and a living allowance but not travel costs.

nationality: Citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with Indonesia

name: VinUniversity Scholarships
description: VinUniversity, a private non-profit university in Hanoi partnered with Cornell University and the University of Pennsylvania, offers merit- and need-based scholarships covering 50-100% of tuition to Vietnamese and international students. Over VND 882 billion has been awarded to students from Vietnam and more than 20 other countries.

name: DOST-SEI Foreign Graduate Scholarship
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI), Philippines
amount: Tuition, living and research allowances for study at reputable overseas institutions
description: The DOST-SEI Foreign Graduate Scholarship funds qualified Filipino students to pursue Master's or PhD degrees in specialized priority fields of science and technology at reputable institutions abroad. It is part of the Philippine government's effort to build advanced local scientific and engineering expertise.

name: SEARCA Graduate Scholarship (Full Master's and PhD Scholarships)
provider: Southeast Asian Regional Center for Graduate Study and Research in Agriculture (SEARCA)
amount: Tuition and fees, travel allowance, thesis, book allowance, health insurance and stipend
description: SEARCA, a SEAMEO regional center headquartered in the Philippines, offers full Master's and PhD scholarships in agriculture and related sciences to nationals of its 11 Southeast Asian member countries. Awards support research addressing food security, farmer income, and climate resilience, and are open to academic, research, or government employees.

nationality: Nationals of SEAMEO member countries (Southeast Asia)

name: JPA (Public Service Department) Scholarship / Biasiswa Persekutuan
provider: Jabatan Perkhidmatan Awam (Public Service Department), Malaysia
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, and travel costs for study locally or overseas
description: Malaysia's Public Service Department offers the Biasiswa Persekutuan (Federal Scholarship) to high-achieving Malaysian students to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate studies at local or overseas universities, in exchange for a public-service bond. It is one of Malaysia's longest-running national scholarship schemes.

name: OCSC Thai Government Scholarship for Study Abroad
provider: Office of the Civil Service Commission (OCSC), Thailand
amount: Full tuition, living allowance and travel costs for study abroad
description: The Office of the Civil Service Commission administers Thailand's national government scholarship programme, funding Thai citizens to pursue undergraduate, Master's or PhD studies at overseas universities, typically in exchange for post-study government service. It is one of the principal channels through which the Royal Thai Government sends Thai scholars abroad.

name: ASEAN Foundation Scholarship / Grant Programmes
description: The ASEAN Foundation, the philanthropic arm of ASEAN headquartered in Jakarta, periodically runs scholarship and grant programmes supporting graduate study and youth development for citizens of ASEAN member states. Specific programmes and funding vary from cycle to cycle.

name: Chevening Scholarship (Pakistan)
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend, travel and other allowances
description: Chevening is the UK government's global scholarship programme funded by the FCDO, offering fully-funded one-year Master's study at any UK university to future leaders. Pakistan is one of the largest Chevening cohorts, with applicants shortlisted and interviewed by the British High Commission in Islamabad.

name: Chevening Scholarship (Bangladesh)
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend, travel and other allowances
description: Chevening is the UK government's global scholarship and fellowship programme, funded by the FCDO, offering fully-funded one-year Master's study at any UK university. Bangladeshi applicants are shortlisted and interviewed via the British High Commission in Dhaka.

name: Chevening Scholarship (Sri Lanka)
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend, travel and other allowances
description: Chevening funds a fully-funded one-year Master's degree at any UK university for future leaders and influencers worldwide. Sri Lankan applicants are shortlisted and interviewed by the British High Commission in Colombo.

name: Chevening Scholarship (Nepal)
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend, travel and other allowances
description: Chevening is the UK government's international scholarships scheme, funded by the FCDO, supporting a fully-funded one-year Master's degree at any UK university. The programme in Nepal is administered through the British Embassy in Kathmandu.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Bangladesh)
provider: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, travel, health insurance
description: Australia Awards are prestigious, fully-funded scholarships offered by the Australian Government for postgraduate study in Australia, intended to build leadership and development capacity in partner countries. Bangladesh has a dedicated annual intake administered through the Australia Awards South Asia & Mongolia programme.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Nepal)
provider: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, travel, health insurance
description: Australia Awards Scholarships provide fully-funded postgraduate study in Australia for Nepali professionals to build skills and leadership capacity for national development. The programme is coordinated through the Australia Awards South Asia & Mongolia office.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Sri Lanka)
provider: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, travel, health insurance
description: Australia Awards Scholarships fund fully-funded postgraduate study in Australia for Sri Lankan professionals, aiming to build people-to-people links and development outcomes between the two countries. Managed through the Australia Awards South Asia & Mongolia programme.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Bhutan)
provider: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, travel, health insurance
description: Australia Awards Scholarships offer fully-funded postgraduate study opportunities in Australia to Bhutanese professionals, supporting development priorities identified jointly by Australia and Bhutan. It is one of the smaller but active country programmes in the Australia Awards South Asia & Mongolia scheme.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Maldives)
provider: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, travel, health insurance
description: Australia Awards Scholarships provide fully-funded postgraduate study in Australia for Maldivian professionals, building skills for national development priorities such as climate resilience and public administration. Administered under the Australia Awards South Asia & Mongolia programme.

name: Inlaks Shivdasani Scholarships
description: The Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation offers merit-based scholarships to young Indian graduates for postgraduate study at leading universities in the USA, UK, and Europe. The award covers tuition, living expenses, one-way airfare, health allowance, and visa costs, decided through a competitive interview process in Mumbai.

name: Rhodes Scholarship for Pakistan
provider: The Rhodes Trust, University of Oxford
amount: Full tuition, stipend (~£19,092/year), airfare and allowances
deadline: Varies by year (typically opens June, closes early August)
description: The Rhodes Scholarship funds full-time postgraduate study at the University of Oxford, selecting two outstanding scholars from Pakistan each year. It covers full tuition fees, an annual living stipend, round-trip airfare, and a settling-in allowance.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (Nepal)
provider: United States Educational Foundation (USEF-Nepal) / U.S. Department of State
amount: Full funding for a US Master's degree (up to 2 years)
deadline: Varies by year (typically closes end of May)
description: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program funds Nepali graduates to pursue a Master's degree at a US university in almost any field except medicine and nursing, administered locally by USEF-Nepal. A small number of nominees are selected annually after a multi-stage interview and testing process.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (Bangladesh)
provider: United States Educational Foundation in Bangladesh (USEFB) / U.S. Department of State
amount: Full funding for a US Master's degree (up to 2 years)
description: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program enables Bangladeshi graduates to pursue Master's study at a US university across most fields, administered by the US Educational Foundation in Bangladesh under the U.S. Department of State's flagship exchange program.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (Sri Lanka)
provider: United States-Sri Lanka Fulbright Commission / U.S. Department of State
amount: Full funding for a US Master's degree (up to 2 years)
description: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program funds Sri Lankan graduates to pursue Master's study at US universities, administered by the United States-Sri Lanka Fulbright Commission. Selection is based on academic merit, leadership potential, and English proficiency.

name: Global Undergraduate Exchange Program (Global UGRAD-Pakistan)
provider: U.S. Department of State (Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs) / IREX
amount: Fully funded one-year non-degree exchange in the US
description: Global UGRAD-Pakistan is a US government-funded exchange program that places Pakistani undergraduates at US colleges and universities for one year of non-degree study, community service, and cultural exchange. It is administered by IREX on behalf of the US Department of State.

name: GREAT Scholarships (Bangladesh)
provider: British Council / GREAT Britain Campaign, in partnership with UK universities
amount: GBP 10,000 tuition-fee award (varies by partner university)
description: GREAT Scholarships are jointly funded by the British Council's GREAT Britain Campaign and partner UK universities, offering tuition-fee awards (typically around GBP 10,000) to students from selected countries including Bangladesh for one-year Master's programmes.
benefits: Partial to substantial tuition fee award

name: DAFI Tertiary Scholarship Programme (Afghan Refugee Students)
amount: Tuition, living stipend and study materials (varies by host country)
deadline: Varies by year and host country
description: The DAFI (Albert Einstein German Academic Refugee Initiative) Scholarship Programme, funded mainly by the German government and administered by UNHCR, supports refugee students, including Afghan refugees hosted in Pakistan, Iran and elsewhere, to pursue Bachelor's degrees. Selection is coordinated through UNHCR country offices and local partner organizations.

name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs / Campus France
amount: Monthly stipend (~EUR 1,181 Master's / EUR 1,700 PhD) plus travel
description: The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme, run by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs via Campus France, supports high-potential foreign students enrolling in Master's or PhD programmes at French institutions. Applications must be submitted by the French host institution on the student's behalf, not directly by the student.

name: Turkiye Scholarships (Turkiye Burslari)
provider: Republic of Turkiye, Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB)
amount: Full funding including stipend, accommodation, tuition, health insurance and flights
description: Turkiye Scholarships is the Turkish government's flagship international scholarship, providing university placement and full financial support to students from around the world at all degree levels. It includes a mandatory Turkish language preparation year for most applicants before starting their degree.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
provider: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea
