amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend, airfare, and Korean language training
deadline: Varies by year (typically Feb-March for graduate track)
description: The Global Korea Scholarship is the South Korean government's premier scholarship program, funding international students for undergraduate and graduate degrees at Korean universities, including a preparatory year of Korean language training. It is administered by NIIED under the Ministry of Education.

name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
deadline: Varies by year (typically April-May, via Japanese embassy)
description: The MEXT Scholarship is the Japanese government's long-running scholarship funding international students for undergraduate, graduate, and research student study at Japanese universities. Applications are usually submitted through the Japanese embassy or consulate in the applicant's home country.
benefits: No obligation to work for the Japanese government after graduation

nationality: All countries with diplomatic relations with Japan

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
amount: Full cost of graduate study at Stanford plus stipend and travel
description: Knight-Hennessy Scholars funds graduate study in any of Stanford University's graduate degree programs for students who show independence of thought, purposeful leadership, and civic mind. It is one of the largest fully-endowed graduate scholarship programs in the world, open to applicants of any nationality.
benefits: Full tuition for a Stanford graduate degree

name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, travel grant, insurance
description: SI Scholarships for Global Professionals fund Master's studies in Sweden for students from a specific list of low- and middle-income countries, aiming to build future leaders with an interest in Sweden. Recipients also join the SI Network for Future Global Leaders (NFGL).

nationality: Selected list of eligible countries (published annually by SI)

name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
provider: Tempus Public Foundation / Government of Hungary
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation contribution
description: Stipendium Hungaricum is the Hungarian government's scholarship programme offering fully-funded higher education places at Hungarian universities to students from partner countries under bilateral education cooperation agreements. It covers all major degree levels and hundreds of English-taught programmes.

nationality: Citizens of partner countries under bilateral agreement with Hungary

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees (EMJMD)
provider: European Commission / European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA)
amount: Monthly living allowance, tuition fees, travel and installation costs
description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees are prestigious, integrated study programmes taught jointly by a consortium of universities in at least two different European countries, funded through the EU's Erasmus+ programme. Selected students receive a full scholarship covering tuition, a monthly stipend, and travel costs while studying at multiple institutions.

name: Beca Presidente de la República
provider: PRONABEC (Programa Nacional de Becas y Crédito Educativo, Ministerio de Educación)
amount: Full funding: tuition, travel, accommodation, food, insurance
description: A Peruvian government scholarship for high-performing professionals with limited economic resources to pursue master's or doctoral studies at one of the world's top 400 universities according to QS, ARWU, or THE rankings. Recipients must return to Peru to work for a period equivalent to double the scholarship duration.

name: Programa de Becas para Estudios Académicos e Investigación de Posgrado
provider: SENESCYT (Secretaría de Educación Superior, Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación)
amount: Full funding for tuition, stipend and travel (varies by agreement)
description: Ecuador's national government scholarship program funds master's and doctoral studies abroad for Ecuadorian professionals, through bilateral agreements with universities and governments in countries including the US, Spain, South Korea, and others. Applicants apply via the SENESCYT PUSAK online platform.

name: Becas Internacionales IFARHU
provider: IFARHU (Instituto para la Formación y Aprovechamiento de Recursos Humanos)
description: Panama's national scholarship agency IFARHU offers international scholarships for Panamanian students and professionals to pursue undergraduate, master's, doctoral and specialization studies abroad through agreements with foreign governments, universities and organizations. Multiple country-specific convocatorias open throughout the year.

name: BECAL - Becas Carlos Antonio López
provider: Programa Nacional de Becas de Posgrado en el Exterior BECAL, Gobierno de Paraguay
amount: Full funding for tuition, stipend and travel
description: BECAL is Paraguay's flagship national scholarship program funding master's, doctoral, postdoctoral, specialization and undergraduate international mobility studies abroad to strengthen the country's advanced human capital. In 2026 the program offered around 259 scholarships in its first-semester convocatoria, applied for through CONACYT's Postulation System (SPI).

name: Convocatoria de Becas Internacionales MESCyT
provider: Ministerio de Educación Superior, Ciencia y Tecnología (MESCyT)
amount: Full funding covering tuition and living costs (varies by destination)
description: The Dominican Republic's Ministry of Education, Science and Technology runs an annual international scholarship convocatoria sending citizens to pursue master's, doctoral and specialty studies abroad. The 2026 (XXII) call planned around 1,800 scholarships across 73 universities and 19 countries, prioritizing STEM fields, requiring a minimum academic index of 80/100 or 3.0/4.0 GPA.

name: Becas en el Exterior - Fundayacucho
provider: Fundación Gran Mariscal de Ayacucho (Fundayacucho), Ministerio de Educación Universitaria de Venezuela
deadline: Varies by year and partner country
description: Fundayacucho is Venezuela's national foundation supporting higher education students through scholarships for study abroad, offered through bilateral agreements with countries such as China, Russia, France, and Turkey. Calls target undergraduate and postgraduate students, teaching staff and administrative personnel of public universities.

name: Open National Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Education, Scholarship and Advanced Training Division, Government of Trinidad and Tobago
amount: Full tuition, fees, airfare and allowances
description: The Government of Trinidad and Tobago awards Open National Scholarships to top-performing secondary school graduates to pursue accredited undergraduate degrees at institutions recognized by the Accreditation Council of Trinidad and Tobago, in Trinidad or abroad. The award covers full tuition and compulsory fees, economy airfare, and living allowances based on country of study.

name: Marcus Garvey Public Sector Graduate Scholarship
provider: Government of Jamaica, Ministry of Education and Youth
amount: Full postgraduate funding for public sector employees
description: Established in 2020 by the Government of Jamaica, this scholarship enables Jamaican public sector employees to obtain a postgraduate degree at accredited universities in Jamaica, North America or Europe. It aims to strengthen public sector leadership capacity through advanced professional training.

name: Becas MAEC-AECID Programa Máster para Ciudadanos de América Latina
provider: Agencia Española de Cooperación Internacional para el Desarrollo (AECID), Gobierno de España
description: AECID's MAEC-AECID scholarship program funds full-time master's degrees in Spain for public employees and professionals integrated into public systems of Latin American countries including Bolivia, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Paraguay, Peru, and the Dominican Republic. It is Spain's cooperation-oriented scholarship targeted at strengthening public institutions in the region.

name: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program
provider: Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF)
amount: Full scholarship covering tuition, living and travel
description: TaiwanICDF offers full scholarships for higher education in Taiwan to students from Taiwan's diplomatic allies, including Latin American and Caribbean nations such as Guatemala, Belize, Paraguay, Haiti, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. The program covers bachelor's, master's and doctoral study at partner Taiwanese universities.

name: Becas de Maestrías y Doctorados en el Exterior en Áreas Estratégicas
provider: ANII (Agencia Nacional de Investigación e Innovación), Gobierno de Uruguay
amount: Full funding including stipend, travel, accommodation, insurance and tuition
description: ANII, Uruguay's national research and innovation agency, funds master's and doctoral studies abroad in strategic sectors for the country's development, open to Uruguayan citizens or foreign residents in Uruguay. Support includes a monthly stipend, flights, accommodation, medical insurance, and tuition financing.

name: In-Region Scholarship Programme Latin America
amount: Monthly stipend plus travel and insurance
description: DAAD's In-Region Scholarship Programme funds master's and PhD study at select universities within Latin America for professionals from the region, aiming to strengthen local capacity to address development-related challenges. The program particularly encourages applications from women and underprivileged groups within the region.

name: Emerging Leaders in the Americas Program (ELAP)
amount: Short-term exchange funding, up to CAD $150,000 per institutional project
deadline: Varies by Canadian host institution (typically March)
description: ELAP is a Government of Canada program advancing education ties with Latin America and the Caribbean by funding short-term study or research exchanges in Canada for students from the region. Scholarships cover airfare, living expenses, health insurance and visa/permit fees, administered through partner Canadian post-secondary institutions.

name: Becas por Nuestro Futuro
provider: Fondo Nacional de Becas, Gobierno de Guatemala
amount: Varies by program level and destination
description: Launched in March 2025 by the Government of Guatemala, this national scholarship fund supports Guatemalan citizens to begin, continue or complete university, graduate and technical studies, both within Guatemala and abroad. Applicants apply online providing national ID, academic records, references and a personal essay.
benefits: Access to national and international study options

name: Programa Presidencial de Becas Honduras 20/20
provider: Secretaría de Desarrollo Social (SEDESOL), Gobierno de Honduras
amount: Varies by modality; national and international scholarship tracks
deadline: Varies by year (recent convocatoria opened June 2026)
description: Created by Executive Decree PCM-013-2017, Honduras 20/20 is the country's presidential scholarship program supporting Honduran students at university and technical levels, including opportunities to study abroad. Applicants must be Honduran nationals aged 17-40, enrolled in an eligible program, with an academic average above 80%.

name: GOAL Scholarship Programme
provider: Government of Guyana, Ministry of Education
amount: Fully funded tuition for approved programs
description: The Guyana Online Academy of Learning (GOAL) is the Government of Guyana's national scholarship initiative funding certificate, associate, bachelor's and postgraduate programs delivered online through partner institutions. Over 54,000 scholarships were awarded between 2021 and 2026, funded fully by the Government of Guyana.
benefits: No formal entry requirements for some tracks

name: Errol Walton Barrow Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Education, Technological and Vocational Training, Government of Barbados
description: Named for Barbados's first Prime Minister, this government scholarship supports undergraduate and postgraduate study for students of newer secondary schools (established after 1951) in Barbados. Applications are submitted through the Ministry of Education, Technological and Vocational Training.

name: Programa de Becas Complementarias para la Investigación Científica
provider: CONACYT El Salvador (Consejo Nacional de Ciencia y Tecnología)
amount: Complementary funding to cover rubrics not financed by other sources
description: CONACYT El Salvador's complementary scholarship program provides supplementary funding for Salvadoran students and researchers whose primary scholarship or grant does not fully cover all study or research costs. The 2026 call remained open from March through November or until funds were exhausted.
benefits: Support for costs not covered by primary scholarship

name: Becas France Excellence Bolivia
provider: Embajada de Francia en Bolivia / Campus France
amount: Tuition exemption, visa fee waiver, CVEC exemption
description: This annual French government scholarship, administered through Campus France Bolivia, funds the second year of a master's degree at a French university or grande école for outstanding young Bolivian professionals. Recipients receive French Government Scholar status, tuition exemption at public universities, free visa processing and CVEC exemption.

name: CAF-UNIR Postgraduate Scholarship Program
provider: CAF - Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean, in alliance with Universidad Internacional de La Rioja (UNIR)
amount: 60% tuition coverage for online official master's programs
description: CAF, the regional development bank of Latin America and the Caribbean, partners with Spain's UNIR to offer scholarships covering 60% of tuition for online official master's degrees in fields strategic to regional development. The program targets civil servants, professionals linked to CAF projects, and students/graduates of CAF training programs across the region.

name: Global Undergraduate Exchange Program (Global UGRAD)
provider: U.S. Department of State, administered by World Learning
deadline: Varies by country (via U.S. Embassy or Fulbright Commission)
description: Global UGRAD is a U.S. government exchange program offering one semester of non-degree undergraduate study, community service, and professional development in the United States for students from partner countries, including Latin American nations such as Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Honduras, and Paraguay. Applications are submitted through the U.S. Embassy or Fulbright Commission in the student's home country.
benefits: Community service and professional development activities

name: President's Scholarship
amount: 100% tuition and lab fees, housing, stipend, insurance, 3 round-trip flights
description: AUS awards up to 20 President's Scholarships annually to outstanding international students who completed secondary school outside the UAE. The scholarship is renewable each year the recipient maintains eligibility.
benefits: Three round-trip air tickets during study period

nationality: International students who completed final secondary year outside the UAE

name: Graduate Merit Scholarship
description: Zayed University automatically considers all entering graduate students, regardless of nationality, for a tiered tuition discount based on their undergraduate GPA. Awards range from a 10% to a 40% tuition reduction and are subject to an annual funding cap.
benefits: Automatic consideration at admission, no separate application

nationality: Open to all nationalities including UAE and international

name: International Student Scholarship
provider: Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), Dubai
description: MAHE Dubai offers international students tuition waivers of up to 50% based on their geographic origin and prior academic grades, assessed during the international admissions process. Additional need-based awards such as the Al Daem and Girl Child scholarships are also available.
benefits: Renewable in subsequent years based on grades

name: Albert Katz International School Scholarship
description: The Albert Katz International School for Desert Studies at Ben-Gurion University offers international Master's and PhD students annual scholarships covering tuition, housing and other living expenses for the duration of their degree.

name: Rothberg International School Graduate Merit Scholarship
fields: The Bible and the Ancient Near East
description: The Rothberg International School offers a limited number of merit scholarships covering full tuition for two years to highly qualified international Master's applicants who have already completed a Bachelor's degree.

name: TAU International Merit Scholarship
amount: Up to $8,000 (up to 50% of tuition) plus monthly allowance
description: Tel Aviv University's Lowy International School offers merit-based scholarships to eligible international undergraduate and graduate students, covering up to 50% of tuition along with a monthly allowance and basic health insurance for one academic year.

name: President's Merit Scholarship Program
description: AUB awards full-tuition merit scholarships each year to a select number of outstanding incoming undergraduate students, identified through their admissions application (high school grades and standardized test scores). Renewal each year requires maintaining a minimum cumulative 85% average.

name: Admission Scholarships
amount: 20% Early Admission Scholarship; up to 40% need-based financial aid
description: NDU offers newly admitted students an Early Admission Scholarship worth 20% of tuition for applying ahead of the regular deadline, plus separate need-based Financial Aid upon Admission that can reach 40% for students with proven financial need and strong academic records.

name: Excellence Scholarship Program
description: AUC's Excellence Scholarship recognizes outstanding academic achievement, exceptional talent, and community service among incoming students holding national, international, or other certificates. Applicants compete against peers holding the same certificate type and must opt in during the online admission application.

name: TICAD8 African Scholarships for STI
provider: Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology (E-JUST)
amount: Fully funded: tuition, stipend, accommodation, flights, insurance
duration: 2 years (MSc, plus up to 6 months preparatory)
description: E-JUST, established with cooperation between Egypt and Japan (JICA), offers fully funded TICAD8 scholarships to African researchers and instructors pursuing MSc or PhD degrees in science, technology and innovation fields. The program covers tuition, a monthly stipend, accommodation, round-trip airfare, and health insurance.

name: Undergraduate Excellence, Merit and International Student Scholarships
provider: German University of Technology in Oman (GUtech)
description: GUtech offers 10 Undergraduate Excellence Scholarships covering 100% of tuition for four years to applicants with at least 95% Grade 12 marks, 20 Undergraduate Merit Scholarships covering 50% of tuition for applicants with at least 90% marks, and a 20% tuition discount available to all eligible international students.

name: Merit Scholarship
description: Işık University evaluates international applicants for merit-based scholarships covering 50% or 75% of tuition based on application documents and interview performance, while Master's (thesis) and PhD applicants may be considered for a full 100% scholarship. IB diploma holders receive separate tuition discounts based on their score.

name: Need-Based Financial Aid Grant
amount: Up to full cost of attendance
description: CMU-Q is a need-blind university that, through Qatar Foundation, offers need-based grants of up to the full cost of attendance to admitted students of any nationality. Applicants apply through the Qatar Foundation financial aid portal alongside their admission application.
benefits: Grant aid up to full cost of attendance

name: Qatar Foundation Merit Scholarship
amount: Tuition, textbooks, and housing for eligible students
description: Georgetown University in Qatar practices need-blind admissions and, through Qatar Foundation, offers merit-based scholarships to returning students who complete two semesters with a cumulative GPA of 3.6 or higher, covering tuition, textbooks, and housing.

name: Qatar Foundation Merit Scholarships (TAMAIUYZ/TAFAWQ)
amount: Merit scholarship plus need-based aid up to full demonstrated need
description: Qatar Foundation offers Education City students at Northwestern University in Qatar merit scholarships after two completed semesters: the TAMAIUYZ Scholarship requires a cumulative GPA of 3.8+ and the TAFAWQ Scholarship requires a 4.0 GPA. Separately, NU-Q and Qatar Foundation provide need-based financial aid that can meet full demonstrated need.
benefits: Need-based aid up to full demonstrated need

name: WCM-Q Scholarship Program
amount: Full tuition, housing, health insurance, travel, stipend
description: Weill Cornell Medicine - Qatar offers fully funded scholarships to talented Qatari and international students pursuing a Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree, covering tuition, housing, health insurance, travel expenses, and a stipend for the duration of the program.
